Ivy Park: FYI — Salacia Labs invoice SAL-2025-07 (USD 12,780) is 75 days overdue. Card on file expired and autopay failed. CS says they're asking for a short deferral. Need collections approach. @Priya can you confirm contract termination clause?

Priya Rao: Contract allows payment plans up to 90 days with written agreement; beyond that Legal review required. We can do a max 3-installment plan without Legal if signed by customer.

Diego Morales: Sales notes: customer says they're in fundraise pause but want to keep access if possible. They asked for 60-day deferral with 1% monthly interest.

Ivy Park: My recommended response: offer 40% now, 30% in 30 days, 30% in 60 days; waive interest if they sign within 48h. Restore service after initial payment clears. If they request >60 days, escalate to Legal.

Samir Qureshi: Fine, but add that we need a signed payment plan and explicit PO if they want to avoid card on file. Also include a standardized late fee after 5 days past due.

invoices-bot: Alert: autopay failed (card expired) for SAL-2025-07 on 2025-11-02. Next retry scheduled 2025-11-18.

Ivy Park: Draft outgoing message below — please review.

Ivy Park:
```
Subject: Payment plan proposal for invoice SAL-2025-07

Hi Samir,

We want to help avoid further disruption. Proposed plan: 40% due immediately, 30% due in 30 days, 30% due in 60 days. We will waive the monthly interest if the payment plan is signed within 48 hours and the initial payment is submitted. Services will be restored once the first installment clears.

Please confirm whether you prefer to pay via card on file or provide a PO and bank transfer details. If we don't receive confirmation within 48 hours, we will start escalation procedures per contract terms.

Thanks,
Ivy Park
Finance Ops
```

Priya Rao: Looks good. Add: "If you need a call, we can do a 15-min sync to finalize." Helps close.

Diego Morales: I'll loop in the account exec and offer to join the call.

Ivy Park: Sending at 11:05 PT. I'll update thread with any reply. If no signed plan in 48h, escalate to collections and copy Legal.

Samir Qureshi: Noted — will monitor.
